audience_moment: A person new to a plan year who wants a local human to explain choices, not a government notice.

focal_element.description: A real advisor, named in the data, photographed simply, large enough to be the person you would call.

stops: one phone in a quiet band

type_pairing.display: Heavy grotesque or a sturdy serif for one short headline
type_pairing.body: Same family, regular, open leading, for one sentence and the required disclaimer

photo_brief.subject: The actual local advisor, capable and still, not a stock couple at a laptop
photo_brief.crop: Head and shoulders, eyes available to the reader, plain wall behind
photo_brief.lighting: Soft daylight, one direction, no glamour retouch

offer_treatment.placement: The headline states the help. No discount numeral. No deadline badge.
offer_treatment.qualifier: That the conversation is no-cost and no-obligation, in one line

response.lockup: One phone, large; code on a light plate with a verb such as scheduling a review. No second agency phone.

trust.front_line: The advisor's name and the agency name, set smaller than the headline
back_only: required plan disclaimer in readable type
